source.caption: Feature importance. Shapley-based feature importance scores for the models estimated on the whole dataset (higher values correspond to more important variables): (a) Random forest, and (b) Neural network. The horizontal axis shows average absolute impact of each predictor on the model output (hatchery yield, %). Only the most important predictors are shown.
